title: AQE Alert Inbox record (D-62)
x_note: AQE writes one JSON object per line (JSONL) to aegis/data/alerts/DATE/inbox.jsonl every 15 min INSTEAD OF EMAIL. The Aegis market-watch session reads this, never the inbox the PM's mail client. Alerts are scoped to TODAY's strong-momentum universe only.

ts.description: ISO8601 UTC time the alert fired (the 15-min AQE cycle)

universe_date.description: the AQE strong-momentum universe date this alert is scoped to — must be TODAY (staleness is rejected)

on_strong_universe.description: AQE asserts this ticker is on today's strong-momentum screen
